hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked crossing points for pedestrians along this stretch of road.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No visible street lights are present, which significantly reduces visibility and perceived safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage and Lack of Surveillance
hazards.description: The long chain-link fence and industrial yard provide no 'eyes on the street,' which can make pedestrians feel isolated and vulnerable.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the sidewalk along the property line

hazards.name: Utility pole obstruction
hazards.description: Utility poles are located in the middle of the narrow walkway on the left side of the street, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street along the fence line

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: The road surface shows significant cracking and patching, which can create tripping hazards or uneven surfaces for pedestrians crossing.

hazards.name: Narrow sidewalk with no buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to parked cars and a high fence, leaving no room for error or comfort.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left side of the image.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven surfaces on the sidewalk increase trip hazards.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross the intersection, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left side is extremely narrow, making it difficult for two people to pass or for those with mobility aids to navigate.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street in front of the row houses

hazards.name: Unmarked Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable lane positioning.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, the main travel way

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Walkway
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or designated pedestrian path, forcing anyone on foot to walk in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire foreground and midground along the fence line

hazards.name: Industrial Vehicle Conflict
hazards.description: The presence of heavy trucks and industrial gates suggests frequent large vehicle movements across the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Background, trucks inside the fenced yard

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance across the unmarked roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark midblock or intersection crossings with high-visibility paint to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the nearest intersections to improve visibility and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Incorporate a planting buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sections of the concrete sidewalk to prevent tripping hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the curb cut to the minimum necessary for safe vehicle access, slowing turning speeds and reducing the pedestrian exposure distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous and safe path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Markings
interventions.description: Apply lane markings to define travel lanes and parking zones, narrowing the perceived roadway to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or humps to physically slow vehicle traffic on this residential block.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk to provide a clear path around utility poles and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone to provide a buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Utility Undergrounding or Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to the edge of the sidewalk or underground to clear the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a buffer between the sidewalk and traffic, while also providing shade and naturally slowing vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide shade, improve the pedestrian environment, and naturally calm traffic by narrowing the perceived roadway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk and relocate utility poles to provide a clear, accessible path of travel.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install frequent, pedestrian-oriented lighting to improve visibility and the perception of safety along the blank industrial frontage.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and widen the sidewalk to ensure a clear, accessible path of travel free from obstructions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Improvements
interventions.description: Repair and complete the sidewalk network, especially on the industrial side, to ensure a continuous and accessible path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to a dedicated furniture zone or widen the sidewalk to ensure a minimum 4-foot clear path of travel.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a furniture zone to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Adding street lights would improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers, enhancing safety and security.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Introducing street trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while improving the environment's appeal.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental-style crosswalk markings at the intersection to improve pedestrian visibility and driver awareness.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffer
interventions.description: Increase the width of the sidewalk and add a furniture or planting zone to separate pedestrians from the roadway.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to improve accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Repair the existing sidewalk and widen it where possible to provide a clear path of travel around utility poles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and widen the sidewalk to provide a consistent, ADA-compliant clear path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Narrowing
interventions.description: Add painted lane lines and parking T-marks to narrow the perceived travel lanes, which naturally reduces vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Roadway Striping
interventions.description: Add lane markings to clearly define the travel lanes and organize vehicle movement.
